hello.speaker: clerk
hello.text: A missing counterseal? There is no missing seal. There is a seal the owners would rather you did not find.

choices.text: [Succubus Spittle] Offer a brief kiss; use the contact to charm him.
Ask about the history of this place.

plain.speaker: clerk
plain.text: A copied ferryman’s receipt from the market notice board would establish your right to inspect.

alternative.speaker: clerk
alternative.text: I will not risk my livelihood on a stranger’s word. Bring evidence. You can still learn what you need without changing my mind.

document.speaker: clerk
document.text: That record settles it. No favour owed.

information.speaker: clerk
information.text: The counterseal is in the Counting House beyond the ferry. It records delegated powers, including the limit on binding people who never signed. The vault keeper keeps its key beside the register.

charmed.speaker: clerk
charmed.text: His reserve softens for this conversation. The counterseal is in the Counting House beyond the ferry. It records delegated powers, including the limit on binding people who never signed. The vault keeper keeps its key beside the register. The warmth fades as you part. Nothing here binds him to silence or loyalty.

resisted.speaker: clerk
resisted.text: He draws away. “That felt like more than a greeting. Speak plainly if you want something.” The attempt fails; ordinary conversation and the evidence route remain open.

lore.speaker: clerk
lore.text: The archlord’s collectors turned help into debt. A meal became a favour, a favour became an oath, and every oath acquired a clause its signer had never seen. Some of us learned not to ask questions. That habit has lasted longer than the fear that taught it.
